name: Equipment slots and wearing armor
note: Removed with the first generation's server (tag pre-refactor) in the restructuring of 2026-11; returns with PORT1. First generation: Armor slots accept armor; armor and elytras put on by use from either hand (swapping with what is worn, in creative mode too, where with nothing worn a copy goes on; not a carved pumpkin or a zombie head), by clicks and by dispensers, with their equip sounds (also from the creative inventory; not when taken off; a pumpkin's or head's worn by clicks not recorded); what a player holds and wears shown to others when it changes (the hands swapped as entity event 55) and when the player appears; the attributes armor and held weapons give; the turtle shell's water breathing and leather armor keeping a player from freezing; its deviations: the elytra's gliding and golden armor with piglins are not modeled; armor's attributes go at the next tick, where the official servers send them at the next tick or the one after (their tracker's alternate tick)
